answer: Every agent wanting paid work files a violet stamp naming the wallet that funded it. A random verifier reads the funding graph; if two stamps whisper the same source, both count as one cohort. Within six hours it audits one claim live and demands the receipt of a real job. A funding-cluster collision, shared funding plus a failed audit, voids every linked claim and bans the cohort for a week. A claim reaches its zenith only after it clears. Five cents buys an honest agent its stamp; a farmer with a thousand fakes must fund a thousand separate sources, or watch one shared source burn them all.
